_doc: Design 125 step 2, the server's own rows (written by scripts/wifi-lookup-fixtures.py - edit the script, not this file). golden: the request for three BSSIDs. apple: fake answers of Apple's service with the APs the server reads ([bssid, lat, lng, acc_m], [bssid, null] = unknown) or malformed. health: failure histories (hours from the first) to the orange line, through the pause steps and integration_health. golden_cells: the cell call for three cells (design 125b). apple_cells: fake answers of a cell call with the towers the server reads ([canonical cell, lat, lng, acc_m], [cell, null] = unknown; then {"ch", "pci"} when either is read, design 137) or malformed.

golden.origin: scripts/wifi-lookup-fixtures.py's own encoder from GrapheneOS's apple_wps.proto (474472e); the protoc check is in the script's docstring

apple.name: unknowns
apple.note: no location, no latitude, Apple's -18000000000, no longitude

apple.name: out_of_range
apple.note: latitude past 90, longitude past 180, accuracy 0, 5001 and -1 (a ten-byte varint) unknown; negative coordinates (ten-byte varints) read

apple.name: macs
apple.note: upper case and short groups normalised; the first of duplicates wins; non-hex, five or 3-digit groups skipped

apple.name: unknown_fields
apple.note: fields of wire types 0, 1, 2 and 5 skipped at every level

health.name: the switch off on every phone

golden_cells.origin: scripts/wifi-lookup-fixtures.py's own encoder from GrapheneOS's apple_wps.proto (474472e); the protoc check is in the script's docstring

apple_cells.name: cells_fresh
apple_cells.note: the contract's cells: LTE and NR known (Apple's MNC 1 for the asked 01; the NR cid over 32 bits), GSM unknown; two surrounding LTE towers, kept in the asked cells' lists (design 137)

apple_cells.name: cells_near
apple_cells.note: the probe's shape: the asked LTE cell (location fields 4, 11, 12; no EARFCN or PCI), 14 surrounding towers - 12 overlap it (9 with EARFCN and PCI, 2 with neither, 1 with the EARFCN alone), 2 don't - and 20 id-less areas (cid -1, 149 km) dropped

apple_cells.name: cells_near_fields
apple_cells.note: design 137 N1: PCI -1 (a ten-byte varint): unknown; PCI 504: unknown; EARFCN length-delimited: unknown; EARFCN 262144: unknown; PCI 503 kept; EARFCN 262143 and PCI 0 kept; EARFCN as fixed32: unknown; sent twice: the last counts; EARFCN past int32; WCDMA's fields; NR's field 6 not read; WCDMA's UARFCN 11 and PSC 12; UARFCN 16384, PSC 512: unknown; GSM's 11 and 12 not read; EARFCN as a group: unknown; a nested group in an unknown field skipped - every tower kept with its position

apple_cells.name: cells_thirteen
apple_cells.note: 13 towers to one cell asked with a count of 12 (and 5 id-less areas, dropped): no throttle

apple_cells.name: cells_two
apple_cells.note: two asked cells 2.2 km apart and three neighbours: X overlaps only A, Y both, Z only B

apple_cells.name: cells_kinds
apple_cells.note: each tower type (SCDMA's field 23 read as WCDMA); accuracy 1 and 50,000 kept

apple_cells.name: cells_unknowns
apple_cells.note: no location, Apple's -18000000000, accuracy 0 and 60 km: unknown

apple_cells.name: cells_dropped
apple_cells.note: a missing TAC, MCC, MNC or cid; a negative cid (a ten-byte varint); GSM's all-ones cid, area 0, NR's all-ones NCI, an MCC of 1000: left out

apple_cells.name: cells_skipped
apple_cells.note: a CDMA tower (field 21) and an AP (field 2) skipped, never cached

apple_cells.name: cells_group_unclosed
apple_cells.note: a group in a tower without its end tag

apple_cells.name: cells_group_mismatched
apple_cells.note: a group in a tower closed by another field's end tag

apple_cells.name: cells_group_in_mcc
apple_cells.note: the MCC as a group: fields 1-5 keep the strict rule

apple_cells.name: cells_group_too_deep
apple_cells.note: groups nested nine deep in a tower
